title: user login with valid credentials
description: Test the user login API endpoint with valid username and password to ensure successful authentication and correct role-based access control.

title: create new certificate
description: Test the certificate creation API endpoint to verify that a new certificate can be created with valid data and is persisted correctly in the SQLite database.

title: edit existing certificate
description: Test the certificate editing API endpoint to ensure that existing certificate details can be updated and changes are saved in the database.

title: delete certificate
description: Test the certificate deletion API endpoint to confirm that a certificate can be deleted and is removed from the database.

title: search certificates
description: Test the certificate search API endpoint to verify that certificates can be searched based on various criteria and correct results are returned.

title: validate certificate
description: Test the certificate validation API endpoint to ensure that certificates are validated correctly according to business rules.

title: view reporting dashboard
description: Test the reporting dashboard API endpoint to verify that all 6 interactive charts display accurate data.

title: export reports to pdf and excel
description: Test the report export API endpoints to ensure reports can be exported successfully to PDF and Excel formats with correct content.

title: update application settings
description: Test the settings update API endpoint to verify that changes to theme, font scaling, and database backup settings are applied and persisted correctly.

title: database backup functionality
description: Test the database backup API endpoint to confirm that the database backup process completes successfully without data loss.
